note: Top-level directory categories. 'slug' matches an existing practice term wherever one exists, because /practice/{slug}/ is live and Google is crawling it — renaming a display name is free, changing a slug is not. 'parent' groups existing terms under a new one; practice rewrites are flat, so a child's URL never changes when it gains a parent. 'reserved' defines a category without showing it: it appears on its own once it has min_listings, which keeps empty shelves out of the primary navigation.

categories.name: Health & Allied Health
categories.note: Restored: 22 listings, the largest category. Physiotherapists, occupational therapists, podiatrists and speech pathologists have no honest home under Massage & Bodywork.

categories.name: Creative Therapies
categories.note: Restored: 10 listings. Named without 'Sound' because sound healing sits under Spirituality and Spa, and two categories claiming it would confuse both.

categories.name: Community & Support
categories.note: Restored: 11 listings. AA, SMART Recovery, grief and peer support groups.

categories.name: Beauty & Self-Care
categories.note: 1 listing. Vocabulary is ready — facials, skin treatments, lashes & brows, nails, waxing — so the category arrives complete on the first salon import.

categories.name: Longevity & Performance
categories.note: No listings of its own yet. Every practice it would show already appears under Spa & Recovery or Allied Health, and two categories listing the same businesses teaches visitors the categories mean nothing. It opens when practices exist that belong here and nowhere else.
